provisioning_notes: Design only: native_active is false, native_ids_admitted is false for every candidate, and no recipe, item, spell, effect, stat bundle, socket, client template, rate, cooldown, duration, range, or material quantity is verified.
Exactly 18 proposals are included: 8 field, 4 masterwork, and 6 legendary. The first three field proposals are standard caster, tank, and melee gems with compatible weapon/armor socket priorities.

Practical bot admission gate 1: classify caster, tank, or melee role and prefer an admitted main weapon or armor host. Read actual item and socket metadata; if gear is gemless white gear, reject the augment and seek an admitted native replacement item.

Practical bot admission gate 2: require real funded inputs, learned profession recipe, skill, level, station, binding, role, and client/item/effect compatibility. Ordinary field goods are not raid-gated; boss-core work requires earned core or pattern and never grants free progress.

Practical bot admission gate 3: persist exact host item GUID, gem/lens/setting identity, socket identity, blueprint version, maker, and collaborators. On equip, unequip, replacement, swap, mail, bank, death, group, or range changes, apply and remove only the admitted lifecycle effect; never duplicate stats, multiply identical auras, or allow proc-on-proc loops.

Jewelcrafting gives identity and customization to useful weapons and armor first. Neck and ring work is bounded and follows funded main-gear demand rather than making the catalogue mostly trinkets; paired resonance is reserved for the masterwork and legendary tiers.

For the selected component or finish, at most one admitted effect profile may be attached. This is not a new global cap on compatible enchants, sockets, legendary effects, or earned personal boss legacies on the finished item.

Legendary entries follow the workshop source exactly: Preparation, Forging or weaving, Tempering, Signature finishing, and Inspection and attunement are five meaningful sequential stages. Each boss core is a real craft input; each signature is one socket- or host-bound budget separate from uncapped personal boss legacies.

A gem, lens, setting, neck, ring, or pair retains exact source/item/socket identity through replacement and trade. Native/client admission and observed save/load/equip/mail/effect removal remain prerequisites before any candidate becomes active.
